scope: Frozen reviewed 115-table modern HRIS schema plus the proposed exact 17 additions only; no canonical, generator, physical-successor, worktree, v1-oracle or v2-policy mutation.

baselineProof.canonicalization: SHA256(UTF8(JSON(sorted tableName array), ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'))))

scopeDecision.qualification: The exact 17 identities are the minimal relational additions if the existing 115 tables are enriched as required and workforce simulation uses the proposed request table as its complete request/result/cancellation lifecycle. This does not accept current producer or reader metadata and does not accept any live candidate implementation.

findings.subject: ppl_wfp_simulation_requests
findings.evidence: Policy v2 names only modern.workforceplan.scenario.simulate, while its own non-replaceability claim requires an immutable result-receipt lifecycle and the frozen P0-WFP-001 minimum contract requires a simulation-result handler. A REQUESTED row cannot become COMPLETED/FAILED, and a pending run cannot become CANCELLED, from that producer set.
findings.requiredClosure: Either (preferred for scalable HRIS) declare exactly modern.workforceplan.scenario.simulate, internal.workforceplan.simulation-result.consume and modern.workforceplan.scenario.cancel as producers with request/result/cancel CAS rules; or formally remodel it as a synchronous immutable COMPLETED simulation-run fact and remove REQUESTED/FAILED/CANCELLED lifecycle claims. Do not claim an async request with a single creator.

findings.subject: sys_hris_ai_assistance_reviews
findings.evidence: The frozen 199-operation surface contains modern.ai.assist.revoke. Human confirmation/rejection and later revocation have the same restricted decision/audit boundary; updating only the mutable assistance root loses the immutable revocation actor/reason/source proof.
findings.requiredClosure: Producer set must be exactly modern.ai.assist.review plus modern.ai.assist.revoke. Review appends CONFIRMED or REJECTED; revoke appends REVOKED linked to the prior review and then changes the assistance root in the same transaction.

findings.subject: acceptanceRules[3]
findings.evidence: Every one of the 17 policy rows declares at least one durable query consumer, but the acceptance rule requires physical read-plan/projection/lineage proof for only ten tables. Seven additions could therefore pass while being unqueryable or digest-only.
findings.requiredClosure: Apply reader closure to all 17 additions: every declared detail/list reader must include the table in readPlan.tables and projectionTuple.physicalSources, bind every exposed durable field to exact table.column lineage, apply field-policy classification/redaction, and prove historical refetch where an event names the fact.

circularAssumptionsRejected: A table name appearing in the author generator or temporary candidate is not evidence that the table is necessary or implementable.
A non-empty nonReplaceability string is not proof; the review below identifies the conflicting baseline table and the integrity or lifecycle fact it cannot retain.
A creator operation is not a complete producer set for an async lifecycle or a reversible human decision.
A digest is not a typed historical result unless an immutable artifact ID, schema version, owner, digest and exact refetch contract all exist.
Generic APPEND_ONLY_REVISION_OR_TERMINAL_ASYNC_STATUS text is not a substitute for table-specific state, interval, predecessor, immutability and reversal rules.
Declaring only ten query-bearing additions does not override the readers declared on all 17 policy rows.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: modern.recruiting.offer.withdraw is an issuer lifecycle action before response and must remain an offer-root/outbox fact; it must not rewrite or fabricate a subject response row.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK tenant+offer_public_id to ppl_rec_offers; unique tenant+offer+decision_revision; actorMode SELF|AUTHORIZED_PROXY; proxy requires delegation/source receipt pair and reason; exactly one terminal ACCEPTED or DECLINED response.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Append-only response decision at ownerClock; no SUPERSEDED state unless a future explicit reversal operation and predecessor link are added.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Recruiting/candidate retention; restricted candidate/actor/subject and confidential offer context; response query redacts by candidate field policy.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: ppl_rec_offers is mutable current state and ppl_rec_candidate_stage_history has a different candidate parent and purpose; neither preserves response actor/delegation/source evidence.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: lifecycle.change changes current operational status only; it does not rewrite version content. Closure/pausing remains on root plus outbox. Content correction/supersession always appends a version.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK tenant+requisition_public_id to ppl_rec_requisitions; unique parent+version; predecessor must reference the same parent; CORRECTION|SUPERSEDE checks; exclusion/non-overlap for effective intervals.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Initial CREATE version plus append-only corrections/supersessions; correction reason mandatory; no published historical row update.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Recruiting definition retention; internal content and restricted owner references; as-of query selects exact effective version.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: The root must keep stable identity/current lifecycle; overwriting root content_digest/validity destroys correction and future-effective lineage.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Template retire/publish changes version/root publication status and never deletes task definitions; journey cancellation affects materialized assignment tasks, not template children.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to exact ppl_jny_template_versions public identity; unique parent+task_key and parent+ordinal; bounded count; actor rule, due anchor/offset, applicability-condition version and completion/evidence schema refs are required.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Children are immutable under their template version; replacement means a new template version and a new complete ordered child set.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Onboarding configuration retention; task definition fields internal; assignment projection exposes only the materialized worker-safe subset.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: The baseline JSONB task_definitions cannot enforce task-key/ordinal uniqueness, relational schema references, bounded cardinality or per-field durable lineage; assignment tasks are instances, not definitions.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Cancel may close only a still-pending run and appends/records cancellation proof; it cannot erase a completed result.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to scenario and exact scenario revision; unique request identity/idempotency tuple; pin input snapshot, assumption/rule revisions, unit/currency/horizon, result receipt ID+revision+schema+digest; result fields all-null or all-present by terminal state.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: REQUESTED -> COMPLETED|FAILED|CANCELLED by exact CAS; immutable input pins and terminal receipt; attempts/retries do not overwrite the first accepted result.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Workforce-planning model retention; population/result fields restricted/aggregated; exact result-artifact refetch with suppression rules.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: ppl_wfp_scenario_revisions mixes scenario design history with result digests and cannot represent multiple independent runs, request retries, terminal receipts or cancellation without conflating design and execution.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Enrollment cancel leaves the historical eligibility fact intact; a later election is a new enrollment/revision and receipt.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to enrollment; exact plan version, eligibility policy version, population snapshot and decision receipt ID+revision+outcome; unique enrollment+eligibility revision; cross-owner proof revalidated before insert.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Append-only ELIGIBLE|INELIGIBLE fact at submission effective time; no recomputation from latest policy.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Benefits/legal election retention; worker and population proofs restricted; query exposes eligibility outcome and audit-safe receipt reference only.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: The mutable enrollment state and separate administrative enrollment_decisions ledger cannot prove the pre-submit policy/snapshot eligibility decision.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Cancellation preserves elected rows; replacement election creates a new parent/version rather than mutating or deleting dependent rows.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to enrollment; unique parent+ordinal and parent+tokenized relationship; exact plan version+coverage option/version proof; bounded cardinality and no raw dependent identity.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Immutable ordered child set for one election revision; no in-place REMOVED state unless a new explicit election revision is linked.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Benefits election retention; relationship token restricted and non-reversible; list/detail queries suppress dependent identity.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: ppl_bnf_enrollments.dependent_tokens JSONB cannot enforce uniqueness/order, bind each relationship to an option/version, or provide per-row field-policy lineage.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Expiry is a system lifecycle outcome on the life-event root, not a fabricated human decision; a future reversal must append a linked SUPERSEDED decision.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to life event; unique event+decision revision; actorMode, actor, subject, delegation/source receipt all-or-none checks; allowed VERIFIED|REJECTED outcomes.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Append-only consequential decision; source/delegation and reason frozen.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Benefits evidence retention; subject/actor/evidence restricted; query exposes audit-safe outcome only by purpose.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: ppl_bnf_life_events stores mutable current status/evidence, while enrollment_decisions has the wrong parent and purpose; neither preserves life-event actor authority.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Revoke appends its own terminal receipt linked to the access request/grant; expiry uses the existing ppl_cwk_access_expiry_receipts and does not overwrite grant proof.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to access request and exact engagement; unique request+result revision; signed owner request/version/digest match; grant ID/revision required for GRANTED/REVOKED.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Append-only GRANTED|DENIED|REVOKED|FAILED owner results; access-request CAS and engagement transition occur in the same inbox transaction.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Contingent access/security retention; grant and worker/vendor context restricted; reader reauthorizes every call.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: The mutable access request retains only the latest result and the expiry receipt proves a different event; engagement status cannot prove signed grant/revoke outcomes.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Reject/offboard update root lifecycle and append their existing domain events; they never erase effective versions. A correction/reversal is a new linked version.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to engagement; unique parent+version; predecessor same parent; CORRECTION|SUPERSEDE; effective interval exclusion; classification policy/decision and access-package intent pins.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Initial CREATE plus append-only effective corrections/supersessions; root owns current workflow state.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Contingent worker/access retention; worker/vendor/classification/access refs restricted; exact as-of projection.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: ppl_cwk_engagements must be the stable identity/current lifecycle root; overwriting classification, access intent or dates destroys effective-time history.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Publish/retire changes root publication lifecycle and leaves all executable versions immutable; a content correction is a new version.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to offering; unique parent+version; predecessor/effective non-overlap; typed content artifact ID+revision+schema, delivery/session, capacity, eligibility policy and skill-taxonomy mappings.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: CREATE plus append-only CORRECTION|SUPERSEDE versions; publication receipt pins exact version.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Learning catalog/completion retention; content internal, learner eligibility restricted; catalog exposes only publishable fields.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: prf_lrn_offerings is mutable current catalog state and content_digest alone cannot reproduce executable content, capacity, sessions, eligibility or skill mapping as-of.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Cancel appends RELEASED for a prior reservation; it never updates/deletes RESERVED or WAITLISTED. Retry uses the original idempotency identity.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to exact offering version and assignment; unique offering-version+entry-sequence and reservation idempotency key; quantity positive; RELEASED references the prior entry; waitlist order monotonic.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Append-only RESERVED|WAITLISTED|RELEASED ledger under row/advisory lock with server-derived availability.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Learning assignment retention; worker/assignment restricted; catalog never exposes learner identities.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: An offering counter or assignment status cannot replay concurrent reserve/release ordering, waitlist priority or idempotent capacity outcomes.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Cancel/close affects root lifecycle; applications and explanations keep their pinned opportunity version. No historical criteria row is deleted.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to opportunity; unique parent+version; criteria artifact ID+revision+schema, capacity and typed skill mappings; application pins exact version; effective interval non-overlap if dated.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Append-only version content; root owns DRAFT|OPEN|CLOSED|CANCELLED lifecycle.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Talent-market retention; criteria internal, applicants/explanations restricted; catalog projection strips protected factors.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: Mutable opportunity content_digest cannot preserve the exact criteria/capacity/skill version used for applications and human explanations.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Reject/retire changes root workflow; restricted version content and audience policy remain immutable. Correction/supersession appends a predecessor-linked version.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to plan; unique parent+version; effective non-overlap; audience policy ID+revision, key position, content artifact ID+revision+digest; specialized restricted-audience PEP on every read.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: CREATE plus append-only CORRECTION|SUPERSEDE; publication receipt pins exact version/audience approval.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Restricted succession retention/legal hold; no employee self exposure by default; evidence/nomination readers require exact audience revision.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: The plan root is current workflow state and its mutable audience/content columns cannot preserve authorization policy and content as-of.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: Submit/plan approval/cycle cancellation change workflow or freeze references; they do not mutate frozen proposal Money. A changed proposal uses CAS and appends a new version.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to proposal; unique parent+proposal_version; worker+assignment, component catalog revision, Money/currency/frequency/basis, FX snapshot when needed, effective date and reason required; Money checks.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Each upsert appends a complete immutable value version; root owns current workflow status.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Compensation/legal retention; Money and worker identity confidential/encrypted; manager population and field policy applied on every query.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: The mutable proposal root cannot reconstruct the exact Money/component/effective values reviewed and later frozen by approval.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: A later plan revision creates a new immutable membership set; snapshot publication consumes, never rewrites, approved membership.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to plan and composite exact proposal+version; unique plan-revision+ordinal and plan-revision+proposal; bounded non-empty set; approved snapshot lines derive server-side from these refs.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Append-only ordered membership frozen in the approval transaction.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Compensation approval retention; IDs restricted and Money resolved only under compensation field policy.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: A plan digest cannot enforce membership/cardinality/FKs or let the server prove which exact proposal versions generated snapshot lines.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: schedule.cancel after approval is a distinct schedule lifecycle event and must not erase the earlier approval; approval-request cancellation remains on the existing request/cancellation receipt contract.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to exact tme_wfm_approval_requests and schedule candidate; unique approval-request+result revision and candidate+candidate revision; signed decision receipt ID+revision/outcome/input digest.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Append-only APPROVED|REJECTED result in the same inbox/CAS transaction; publish admission requires matching APPROVED receipt.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: Time/scheduling approval retention; workforce identities restricted; candidate detail/list expose audit-safe approval state only.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: The mutable approval request and candidate state can retain only the current outcome and cannot independently prove the signed decision used by publish admission.

tableReviews.reversalCancelDisposition: assist.cancel before production has no review row; assist.revoke after confirmation appends a REVOKED decision linked to the prior review and never mutates the original confirmation.
tableReviews.parentAndIntegrity: FK to assistance request and prior review on revoke; unique assistance+review_revision; subject/requester ownership, actor mode, actor, reason, delegation/source receipt all-or-none; human decision cannot target another subject.
tableReviews.stateEffectiveImmutability: Append-only CONFIRMED|REJECTED|REVOKED human decisions; mutable assistance root reflects current state only.
tableReviews.retentionAndFieldPolicy: AI decision/provenance retention is separately configurable; subject/actor/reason restricted; raw prompts/results remain forbidden from review events.
tableReviews.why115CannotAbsorb: AI provenance proves model generation, not the separate human action; the mutable assistance root cannot retain actor/delegation/reason or a later immutable revocation.

allTableControlRequirements.rowSecurity: ENABLE and FORCE tenant RLS; NO BYPASSRLS service role; no default grants.
allTableControlRequirements.retention: Every table pins a named owner-session retention policy version; legal hold and purge/tombstone behavior are explicit; decision/evidence/config lifecycles are not conflated.
allTableControlRequirements.fieldPolicy: Every direct durable response field has exact table.column lineage and sensitivity/tokenization; unknown field/purpose/population is denied; list and detail readers are both checked when declared.
allTableControlRequirements.foreignKeys: All same-owner parent identities and exact child-version identities use tenant-scoped local FKs; cross-owner identities use typed public-ID/revision contracts with fail-closed owner refetch, never database cross-service FKs.
allTableControlRequirements.immutability: Append-only facts reject UPDATE/DELETE except narrowly defined terminal CAS on true async request roots; reversals append predecessor-linked facts.
allTableControlRequirements.effectiveTime: Effective-dated versions have predecessor integrity, CORRECTION|SUPERSEDE semantics and non-overlap/exclusion checks; as-of reads never fall back to latest.
allTableControlRequirements.events: Events contain exact durable IDs/revisions and audit-safe state, never raw sensitive content; every refetch points to an exact historical reader or is explicitly forbidden with sufficient immutable payload.

acceptanceConditions: Revise the policy successor (without rewriting v2) so WFP and AI producer sets equal the complete sets in this report.
Replace the ten-table reader shortcut with all-17 reader/lineage/field-policy closure.
Generate a 132-table candidate whose table set is exactly frozen115 union exact17 and whose removed set is empty.
Prove every table-specific parent/FK/state/effective/immutability/retention/field-policy rule in this report in exact schema, operations/handlers, events and physical PostgreSQL evidence.
Run the independent validator and its mutation self-tests, then run the global live acceptance and physical PG16/PG18 validators. This report alone never opens G3.

reproducibility.expectedCurrentResult: FAIL with exactly three P0 findings: incomplete WFP producer set, incomplete AI producer set, and ten-of-seventeen reader shortcut.
